'''Rovair''' is a noble born [[Lord]] from [[Tear]].

== Appearance ==
Rovair is stout.

== Activities ==
He is part of [[Darlin Sisnera]]'s rebellion that is situated in [[Haddon Mirk]]. He is with Darlin when they find [[Rand al'Thor]] and [[Min Farshaw]] in the woods. He is forced to give his horse to Rand to ride.{{ref/book|7|35}}
